model.title: Board of Veterans Appeals Annual Report Transparency Act of 2025
model.meta: Veterans' Affairs Committee · Rep. Keith Self (R-TX)

summary.text: The bill would require the Board of Veterans' Appeals to identify and report on the reasons why some veteran appeals are not decided promptly and why cases are being sent back for further review, aiming to increase transparency about delays in the appeals process.
